body.statement: Fix \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{SI}}\subset\Lambda_{\mathrm{SI}}\). If every rule premise and path predicate is decidable uniformly in time polynomial in \(D\), \(K\), and the encoding length of \(\mathcal O\), and every conclusion changes a reported circle endpoint once to a tail or arrowhead, then saturation makes at most \(2(K+1)D(D-1)\) strict reported-endpoint updates and computes \(\operatorname{Cl}_{\mathcal R}(\mathcal O)\) in polynomial time. The observational skeleton and unshielded colliders on \(U_0=V\), together with the complete skeletons and unshielded-collider families of the faithful pooled selected-law signatures on \(U_k\), \(k\in[K]\), including all indicator adjacencies and indicator-involving unshielded colliders, remain immutable inputs. If additionally \(\operatorname{Cl}_{\mathcal R}(\mathcal O)=\mathcal P_{\mathrm{SI}}(\mathcal O)\), this polynomial output is the canonical SI-PAG and no enumeration of \(\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\) is required.
body.justification: This conditional closure-accounting corollary records the computational consequence of a fixed finite grammar and one-way endpoint updates.
body.gap: The proposition is not an independent novelty claim; its substantive identification content comes entirely from the complete-calculus theorem.
body.consumer: An implementation can audit rule-predicate complexity before using complete saturation on a perturbation panel.
